study_role: Post-review sensitivity study. No claim of pre-registration before the earlier Atlas results.
scope: Two original lung crops from one development donor; no breast width sweep.
physical_displacement: p*|h|/sqrt(2); band |h|<=3B/4. Caps are proposed maxima; actual accepted widths are reported.
extraction: Existing geometry-only candidate ordering, source half-ribbon containment, disjointness, nuclear constraints and fallback widths; repeated exact rational geometry verification. Atlases need not be nested.
proseg: Reuse actual3.2.0 no-factorization outputs. Exact transcript-ID intersection; compare retained shared molecules only. Map cell indices through original_cell_id and input mask_label. Ignore diffused coordinates and retain original observed coordinates.
nuclear: Five micrometre nearest labelled nuclear pixel with existing five micrometre crop-border guard. Excluded molecules carry zero score but remain as geometric collateral.
guarantee: Exact cell/gene marginal count reach, including holes in score spectrum. No full assignment-vector, accuracy or calibration claim.
limits: Chain per-call timeout120s; timeout/error causes explicit incomplete result, never a certified interval. No outcome-based parameter changes.
primary_outputs: changed-count reach by budget and unlimited
all exact count minima and witnesses
portability_amendment: Previously executed Proseg outputs are copied byte-for-byte into results/proseg; runner default is package-relative. No scientific parameters/results changed.
final_replay_scope: Same caps, fallback ladders, observed populations, geometry and budget grid. Final source includes explicit point-input contract checking; all study free RNA were already points. Every recorded numerical spectrum/CSV/witness will be compared with the initial runs. This is a software replay, not an independent experiment.
